turns.utterance: is Zoom auto-provisioned at the company or do I need to request access?
turns.reply:
Got it — you’re asking whether Zoom is automatically provisioned or if you need to request access.

Zoom Phone access depends on your role: some roles are auto-provisioned, and others need an access request. You can quickly check if you’re already provisioned by opening the Zoom desktop app and looking for the Phone tab (it may be under More). If you don’t see Phone, you’ll need to submit a request using one of these links:

https://indeed.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ITKB/pages/752324540
https://indeed.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1/group/1/create/1
https://indeed.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ITKB/pages/733315292

When you submit the request, include: Full Name, Email address, Role, Team, Business Justification, and a Manager approval comment. If you need a specific area code or multiple regions, note that in the ticket. For most client-facing Sales, CS, and SBS roles, Zoom Phone is granted by default; for other roles, a ticket is usually required.

Are you asking about basic Zoom meetings/chat access, or specifically Zoom Phone (calling/phone number) access?
